name: Nine Inch Nails

whyMatters.en: Trent Reznor’s Cleveland studio project, started in 1988. The Downward Spiral (1994) brought sequenced aggression, distorted vocals, and programmed dynamics to US rock mass media.
whyMatters.zh: Trent Reznor 的克利夫兰录音室项目，1988 年起步。The Downward Spiral（1994）把音序攻击、失真人声与程序动态送进美国摇滚大众媒介。

lyricQuotes: I want to fuck you like an animal
I hurt myself today / To see if I still feel

shortBio.en: Reznor industrial rock; studio as primary instrument. Closer and Hurt bracket the 1994 peak.
shortBio.zh: Reznor 工业摇滚；录音室为主要乐器。Closer 与 Hurt 框住 1994 高峰。

body.en:
Started in Cleveland in 1988 as a one-man studio band. Pretty Hate Machine and the Broken EPs built the live / industrial hybrid; The Downward Spiral and The Fragile are dense peaks—sampling, ring-modulated vocals, programmed drums beside live kits.

Closer (1994) is the MTV / radio spike; Hurt documents the quiet side. 1990s rock dynamics here are built from sequencers and still play on rock radio.

Reznor is the only constant member. The 1988 tour used drummer Ron Musarra and keyboardist Chris Vrenna. Pretty Hate Machine (1989): a Bowie line in the Chinese edition calls it the industrial-rock record that first reached a mainstream audience. At Lollapalooza with Guns N’ Roses, Jeff Ward sat in on drums and Richard Patrick played guitar. Broken (1992) made the US top 10, with PiL drummer Martin Atkins. The Downward Spiral (1994) uses Adrian Belew, plus Danny Lohner and Robin Finck in the live band. Vrenna was back for Woodstock, August 1994. Twenty-six dates with David Bowie followed, billed around 1.Outside.

The Fragile (1999) introduced drummer Jerome Dillon. Guests include Page Hamilton (Helmet), Mike Garson, and Bill Rieflin (Ministry, later R.E.M.). On With Teeth (2005) Dave Grohl plays drums on half the songs; Atticus Ross is credited as designer, then co-producer. The Year Zero tour used Aaron North, Jeordie White, Alessandro Cortini, and Josh Freese. The 2009 run, billed with Jane’s Addiction, used Ilan Rubin. Reznor and Ross scored The Social Network (2010). Hesitation Marks came out in 2013.
body.zh:
1988 年于克利夫兰以一人录音室乐队起步。Pretty Hate Machine 与 Broken EP 建立现场 / 工业混合；The Downward Spiral 与 The Fragile 是密集高峰——采样、环形调制人声、程序鼓与真人鼓组并存。

Closer（1994）是 MTV / 电台尖峰；Hurt 记录安静面。此处 1990 年代摇滚动态由音序器搭建，仍能上摇滚电台。

Reznor 是唯一固定成员。1988 年巡演是鼓手 Ron Musarra 与键盘 Chris Vrenna。《Pretty Hate Machine》（1989）：中文版所引 Bowie 的话，称它是工业摇滚里第一张真正打进主流的唱片。与 Guns N’ Roses 一起上 Lollapalooza 时，Jeff Ward 代打鼓，Richard Patrick 担任吉他。《Broken》（1992）进入美国榜前 10，PiL 鼓手 Martin Atkins 参加。《The Downward Spiral》（1994）有 Adrian Belew，现场乐队加上 Danny Lohner 与 Robin Finck。1994 年 8 月伍德斯托克，Vrenna 回到鼓位。随后与 David Bowie 演了 26 场，宣传《1.Outside》。

《The Fragile》（1999）换上鼓手 Jerome Dillon。客席包括 Helmet 的 Page Hamilton、Mike Garson，以及 Ministry、后来参加 R.E.M. 的 Bill Rieflin。《With Teeth》（2005）里 Dave Grohl 打了一半的鼓；Atticus Ross 先记为设计，再升为联合制作。Year Zero 巡演是 Aaron North、Jeordie White、Alessandro Cortini 与 Josh Freese。2009 年与 Jane’s Addiction 同台的巡演用 Ilan Rubin。Reznor 与 Ross 为电影《社交网络》（2010）配乐。《Hesitation Marks》发行于 2013 年。

title.zh: 工业音序登上摇滚电台

body.en:
Pretty Hate Machine (1989) crosses synth-pop hooks with drum-machine kick. The Downward Spiral (1994) densifies: layered noise, tape loops, Reznor’s whisper-to-scream vocal.

Closer and Hurt share one album cycle—sequencer-built tracks on the same playlists as guitar bands.
body.zh:
Pretty Hate Machine（1989）把 synth-pop hook 与鼓机底鼓交叉。The Downward Spiral（1994）加厚：叠层噪声、磁带 loop、Reznor 耳语到嘶吼的人声。

Closer 与 Hurt 同属一专辑周期——音序器搭建的曲目与吉他乐队同列播放列表。

title.zh: 一人录音室与巡演乐队

body.en:
Reznor writes and records alone; live NIN expands to guitar, dual keys, bass, and drums. Finck, Lohner, and Vrenna define the 1994–96 tour silhouette.

Atticus Ross joins production from With Teeth onward; Ilan Rubin holds the live drum chair after 2009. Catalog cites Reznor first; live roster is the second layer.

Woodstock 1994 and the 1995 Bowie dates are the live nodes in the entry. Grohl drums on half of With Teeth. The 2009 bill paired the live band with Jane’s Addiction.
body.zh:
Reznor 独自写作录音；现场 NIN 扩成吉他、双键盘、贝斯、鼓。Finck、Lohner、Vrenna 定义 1994–96 巡演剪影。

Atticus Ross 自 With Teeth 起加入制作；Ilan Rubin 2009 年后守现场鼓席。目录先引 Reznor；现场名单是第二层。

条目里的现场节点是 1994 年伍德斯托克，以及 1995 年与 Bowie 的 26 场。Grohl 在《With Teeth》里打了一半的鼓。2009 年巡演与 Jane’s Addiction 同台。

alt.en: Trent Reznor with Nine Inch Nails, California, 21 May 2009
alt.zh: Trent Reznor 与 Nine Inch Nails，加利福尼亚，2009 年 5 月 21 日

title.en: Studio aggression in alt-metal and electronic rock
title.zh: 录音室攻击进入 alt-metal 与电子摇滚

body.en:
Deftones and Radiohead cite the textural side—noise beds beside melody. Reznor’s film-score work with Ross extends the studio method beyond NIN albums.

Influence is production practice: distorted vocals, loop-based verses, and dynamic cuts that nu-metal and 2000s alt adopted widely.
body.zh:
Deftones 与 Radiohead 引用纹理面——旋律旁的噪声铺底。Reznor 与 Ross 的电影配乐把录音室方法延伸到 NIN 专辑之外。

影响是制作做法：失真人声、loop 主歌与动态切换，被 nu-metal 与 2000 年代 alt 广泛采用。

label.zh: Downward Spiral 录音室 / 本人

note.en:
Reznor as primary author; live band rotates around the catalog.

Live chairs rotate: Vrenna, Patrick, Lohner, Finck, Clouser, Dillon, then the 2005–09 North / White / Freese / Rubin groups. Reznor stays.
note.zh:
Reznor 为主要作者；现场乐队围着目录轮换。

现场座位轮换：Vrenna、Patrick、Lohner、Finck、Clouser、Dillon，然后是 2005–09 的 North / White / Freese / Rubin 几组。Reznor 留下。
